# Vacation Math

> Free 2026 vacation cost calculators and the Tuesday Travel Math newsletter. Honest, itemized trip math — no hype.

Vacation Math (https://vacationmath.co) is a free static site of 2026 vacation cost calculators. Founder Chris Bacon lives in Orlando, Florida. Canonical host: https://vacationmath.co (no www).

The site prices real trips before you book: cruises, Disney World / Disneyland, all-inclusive resorts, theme parks, road trips, Europe/Hawaii-style big trips, points vs. cash, timeshare math, when to book, and a reverse budget calculator. Tuesday Travel Math is the weekly newsletter and lives at /blog/.
